prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original Greek god bust portrait illustration for a civilization chess game's active skill card. Classical engraved woodcut / copperplate drawing, detailed flowing beard, strong face, dignified anatomy, bold readable silhouette, fine expressive hatching but not noisy. Monochrome warm ivory and muted antique gold ink designed to read on a dark green game UI. Transparent background, no white rectangle, no text, no letters, no frame, no watermark. Square composition, full head and shoulders and signature object visible, centered, generous 8% margin. NOT a flat geometric pictogram. Subject: Zeus, stern mature bearded sky god in three-quarter view facing right, laurel wreath, draped Greek robe, right hand holding a large jagged lightning thunderbolt prominently next to his face. Bust from chest up. Original composition in vintage book engraving style.
